actions.desc: Each creature the chained angel can see within 50 feet of it must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 19 (3d12) radiant damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.desc: When a creature the chained angel can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell that appears on the cleric or paladin spell list, the chained angel can counter the spell with a successful ability check. This works like the counterspell spell with a +5 spellcasting ability check, except the chained angel must make the ability check no matter the level of the spell.

traits.desc: The chained angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.desc_ru: Совершает спасброски от заклинаний и прочих магических эффектов с преимуществом.
traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.desc: When a creature casts the knock spell on the chained angel’s chains, the chains release a blast of unholy flame. The spellcaster must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage and 16 (3d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the spellcaster survives, the chained angel must immediately make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the angel’s chains fall away. It is restored to its senses and the form it had before it was chained, typically a deva. On a failure, the chained angel remains chained for 7 days, and during that time, any further attempts to cast knock on the angel’s chains fail.

ru.description: Средний небожитель, мировоззрение: нейтрально-злое. Класс доспеха: 16 (природный доспех). Хиты: 121 (22к8 + 22). Скорость: ходьба 60 фт., полёт 30 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 18, ЛОВ 16, ТЕЛ 12, ИНТ 12, МУД 18, ХАР 20. Сопротивление урону: колющего. Иммунитет к урону: огнём, излучением. Иммунитет к состояниям: очарование, истощение. Чувства: тёмное зрение 200 фт., пассивное Восприятие 17. Показатель опасности: 8. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 3, действий: 4.
ru.name: Чаинед ангел
